shared_elements: repeated geometric elements arranged in a row
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow schematic relief with a disc/ring motif and repeated elements set out in horizontal bands, but that is about as generic as carved decoration gets. A is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic pillar with a head, a large central concentric disc on the torso and belt-like arcs, while B is a flat panel divided into registers of repeated pendant/tongue shapes, a zigzag lattice band and a small standing figure among them — no specific motif recurs in the same relationship.
